sentimento.text1: With 63 days to the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), there was NO fresh national polling, and there is now a date for the next one. The most recent remains Vox Brasil of Jul 31 (n=2,100, fieldwork Jul 26 to 28, 2.15pp margin, 95% confidence, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) filing BR-01084/2026): Lula 40.5% against Flávio Bolsonaro 31.2% in the first round, with Caiado 5.5%, Zema 3.2% and Renan Santos 3.0%, and 47.5% against 41.1% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). Today's TSE sweep read 538 filings and inserted none, which confirms on the filing side what the press confirms on the publication side. FOUR national polls are in the field right now: two from Nexus, one from [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) and one from Ideia/Canal Meio, with publication declared between Aug 3 and Aug 5. A declared date on a filing is not publication, and the panel will check each one. The day's polls are STATE-LEVEL and therefore do not enter the national panel: [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) in Pernambuco has Lula 57% against Flávio 22% in that state, and Genial/Quaest shows Lula ahead in four states and Flávio in one.
sentimento.text2: Today's cross-reading inverts the mechanism of the two before it. Lula held FLAT at 65.50% and the gap WIDENED from +40.75pp to +40.95pp, but it widened because FLÁVIO FELL 0.20pp, not because the favourite rose. In the two previous sessions the record came with the rival rising alongside; today it is the opposite, and the difference matters for the reading. The series high is now behind us, and the window has to be stated in full: the maximum is 66.50%, from the Aug 1 close, and the maximum gap is +41.80pp from that same day, both above what the panel shows today. The AFOS series runs from Apr 14 to today, 108 days, and was checked straight against the database. RENAN SANTOS is the move of the day: UP 0.35pp to 7.95% (vol USD 8.82M), BREAKING a losing streak that had lasted nine rounds, on the same day Missão formally launched his candidacy. The panel records the coincidence of dates and does not claim causation.
sentimento.text3: In the market, Lula held FLAT at 65.50% (vol USD 7.90M) and Flávio FELL 0.20pp to 24.55% (vol USD 7.82M), breaking six sessions without a decline, and it is that fall which widens the gap to +40.95pp. Renan Santos ROSE 0.35pp to 7.95% (vol USD 8.82M). The chasing pack split, unlike yesterday, when it shrank as a whole: Camilo Santana rose 0.20pp to 0.65% (vol USD 4.27M), Jair Bolsonaro rose 0.10pp to 0.65% and Haddad rose 0.05pp to 0.30% (vol USD 6.63M), while Caiado fell 0.20pp to 1.15% (vol USD 5.27M), Zema fell 0.10pp to 0.25% (vol USD 4.64M), and Michelle and Tereza Cristina each fell 0.10pp, both to 0.15%. Alckmin held at 0.35% and Tarcísio de Freitas remains at 0.05%, with USD 13.70M in accumulated volume, the largest in the book. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market is USD 118.11M, against USD 117.52M yesterday.
sentimento.direita: Flávio FELL 0.20pp to 24.55% (vol USD 7.82M), breaking six sessions without a decline, and it was his fall that WIDENED the gap to +40.95pp, because Lula stood still. In the sub-markets the signal runs the other way, and the panel does not pick between them: he is UP 1.00pp in second place in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), at 80.50% (vol USD 217K), his highest mark in that contract over the panel's coverage, and effectively flat in third place, at 4.90%. He gives ground on the chance of winning and gains on the chance of reaching the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), in the same session. On the ticket, he still has NO running mate three days from the Aug 5 deadline. Valor Econômico records that he and Lula reached the final stretch of the convention season without broadening alliances, with the [Centrão](/en/glossary#centrao) still neutral, and the [Republicanos](/en/glossary#republicanos) national convention, which decides the presidential alliance, is on Aug 4. At the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) convention in Santa Catarina he asked for votes ahead of the legal window, which only opens on Aug 16, and used a new video with Jair Bolsonaro after Moraes questioned him over the previous one, generated by artificial intelligence. Carlos Bolsonaro criticised the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) from the same stage.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula held FLAT at 65.50% (vol USD 7.90M) on the day the [PT](/en/glossary#pt) formally launched his candidacy. The gap WIDENED to +40.95pp through the rival's fall, not his own rise, which changes the mechanism relative to the two previous sessions. Today's price is 1.00pp BELOW the series high, which is 66.50%, from the Aug 1 close. The PT national convention, in São Paulo, confirmed the ticket with Alckmin as running mate and brought together seven parties, in Lula's eighth run for the presidency and his bid for a fourth term. He said he does not want to be the Bolsa Família president and promised to fight the Congress over earmarks, and Tebet called Flávio a coup-monger from the stage. He also asked for votes ahead of the legal window, which opens on Aug 16, and Flávio did the same on the same day. In his camp the market rose: Camilo Santana gained 0.20pp to 0.65%, and Haddad gained 0.05pp to 0.30%. Alckmin held at 0.35%. On the judicial axis, the two inquiries into Lulinha sharpened the tension between Mendonça and the Federal Police, his lawyer accuses parts of the [PF](/en/glossary#pf) of trying to interfere in the election, and Roberta Luchsinger asked for an investigation into leaked conversations. An inquiry is not a conviction.
sentimento.terceiraVia: The chasing pack SPLIT, and that is the difference from yesterday, when it shrank as a whole. RENAN SANTOS is the move of the day: UP 0.35pp to 7.95% (vol USD 8.82M), breaking nine rounds of decline, and he also rose in both placement books, 0.20pp in second place, to 8.75%, and 2.00pp in third place, to 63.50% (vol USD 168K), where he is the outright favourite. The turn does not undo the arc, and the window has to be stated: he came from 12.00% on Jul 23 and touched 7.10% at the Aug 1 close, and it is NOT a series low, because the low is 5.30%, from Apr 26, and the high is 17.90%, from Jun 9. With the price rising and polling stuck at 3.0%, the distance between market and polling WIDENED AGAIN, from 4.60pp to 4.95pp. CAIADO touched the series floor within the day itself: the 11:30 UTC collection recorded 0.90%, matching the lowest value since Apr 14, already registered between Jul 5 and Jul 9, and the locked capture at 19:42 UTC shows 1.15%, down 0.20pp in a fourth straight session of decline. The panel publishes the locked capture and records the intraday floor rather than picking between the two. In third place he is UP 2.00pp, to 24.50%, recovering the previous day's fall. CAMILO SANTANA rose 0.20pp to 0.65%, and a collection caveat belongs here: the AFOS series has no Aug 1 point for that name, so the panel does not repeat the series-low sentence it published yesterday. ZEMA fell 0.10pp to 0.25%, and his series has no point after Jul 30.
sentimento.polymarket: Lula 65.50% (flat, vol USD 7.90M), Flávio 24.55% (down 0.20pp, vol USD 7.82M), Renan Santos 7.95% (up 0.35pp, vol USD 8.82M), Caiado 1.15% (down 0.20pp, vol USD 5.27M), Jair 0.65% (up 0.10pp), Camilo Santana 0.65% (up 0.20pp, vol USD 4.27M), Alckmin 0.35% (flat), Haddad 0.30% (up 0.05pp), Zema 0.25% (down 0.10pp), Michelle 0.15% (down 0.10pp), Tereza Cristina 0.15% (down 0.10pp), Tarcísio 0.05% (flat, vol USD 13.70M). Lula's gap over Flávio at +40.95pp, against +40.75pp in the capture published on Aug 1, and BELOW the series maximum, which is +41.80pp at the Aug 1 close. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market at USD 118.11M. Sub-markets: second place in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with Flávio at 80.50% (up 1.00pp, vol USD 217K), Renan Santos at 8.75% (up 0.20pp, vol USD 1.09M) and Lula at 7.55% (down 0.85pp); third place with Renan at 63.50% (up 2.00pp, vol USD 168K), Caiado at 24.50% (up 2.00pp, vol USD 37K), Flávio at 4.90% and Zema at 4.60% (flat); impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice FLAT at 3.10% (vol USD 83K) for a fourth session; Senate with [PL](/en/glossary#pl) FLAT at 72.50% (vol USD 259K) and [MDB](/en/glossary#mdb) at 18.75%, down 2.60pp in a book of USD 8K; inflation with the 5.00% to 5.49% band at 34.75% and the 4.50% to 4.99% band at 27.00%. The double-reading lock PASSED the round, with no blocking reason at all, both readings within 0.20pp across every book. All prices enter firm, with no declared range. Live capture Aug 2 at 19:42 UTC.

inss.text1: The fiscal agenda had no fresh news this Sunday, and Congress returns this week, alongside the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) coming back from recess and the Aug 5 deadline for ticket registration. The political day was one of NATIONAL CONVENTIONS, on both sides. The [PT](/en/glossary#pt) formally launched Lula in São Paulo, with Alckmin as running mate and seven parties in the alliance, in his eighth run for the presidency. Missão formally launched Renan Santos, also in São Paulo. And Flávio Bolsonaro attended the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) convention in Santa Catarina. Lula and Flávio both asked for votes ahead of the legal window, which only opens on Aug 16, and the record covers both, not one. Valor Econômico sums up the balance of the convention season: the two reached the final stretch without broadening alliances, and the [Centrão](/en/glossary#centrao) remains neutral.
inss.text2: The market inverted the mechanism of the two previous sessions. Lula held FLAT at 65.50% and the gap WIDENED to +40.95pp, but it widened through Flávio's fall, as he gave up 0.20pp to 24.55%, breaking six sessions without a decline. In the two days before, the gap widened with the rival rising alongside; today it is the reverse. The series high is now behind us: the maximum is 66.50%, from the Aug 1 close, and today's price is 1.00pp below it. RENAN SANTOS ROSE 0.35pp to 7.95% (vol USD 8.82M), breaking nine rounds of decline, on the same day as the convention that formally launched him. The chasing pack split: Camilo Santana and Jair Bolsonaro rose, Caiado and Zema fell. The asymmetry of the day is the same as yesterday's: none of it had national polling to track it, and the most recent remains Vox Brasil of Jul 31.
inss.text3: The market on the impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice held FLAT at 3.10% (vol USD 83K), with no variation across the two readings of today's capture lock, in a fourth straight session at the same value. The judicial axis did produce news in the period, with the inquiries into Lulinha sharpening the tension between Mendonça and the Federal Police, but none of it targets a member of the Court, which is the object of this contract. With USD 83K in accumulated volume against USD 118.11M in the presidential market, this contract is only worth recording when it moves in a sustained way.
inss.text4: In the Senate, the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) held FLAT at 72.50% (vol USD 259K), and the [MDB](/en/glossary#mdb) FELL 2.60pp to 18.75%, in a book of USD 8K that does not support a repricing reading. Together, the two carry more than 91% of the probability assigned to just two parties, which on its own indicates a wide spread. On inflation, the modal band remains 5.00% to 5.49%, which FELL 3.45pp to 34.75%, and the 4.50% to 4.99% band FELL 7.00pp to 27.00%, in a book NOT covered by the lock. And there is a coherence caveat the panel measures and publishes rather than hides: the ten bands add up to 94.15%, below the 95% floor AFOS uses before treating a distribution as readable probability. The levels enter as a collection record, not as a reading of expectations.
inss.impactoLula: Vox Brasil of Jul 31 did not publish approval and disapproval, and no national poll has been published since, so the assessment picture remains the one from Jul 30, with the week's two opposing readings still standing: PoderData measured personal approval falling to 43% against 49% disapproval, and AtlasIntel, 24 hours earlier, measured it rising 1.7pp to 47.6% against 51.2%. The panel still displays AtlasIntel on the gauge under the criterion published on Jul 29, the largest sample and the smallest margin in the set. The week's range remains between 43% and 49%. Four national polls are in the field and should publish between Aug 3 and Aug 5, which should redo this picture within the week.
inss.impactoGestao: With no fresh national round, the picture on government performance remains the one from Jul 30, and the week's two readings still point in opposite directions. PoderData of Jul 30 brought 34% rating it great or good, 16% fair and 47% poor or terrible, with poor or terrible up 10pp against the institute's Jul 22 round. AtlasIntel of Jul 29 measured 49.3% poor or terrible, [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) of Jul 27 measured 43% and [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) of Jul 24 measured 38%. The four institutes still agree on what matters most here: the administration is rated worse than the person, and the distance between the two indicators persists.
inss.conclusao: With 63 days to the election, the day brought national conventions on both sides and an inverted mechanism in the market. The favourite stood still at 65.50% and the gap widened to +40.95pp because the rival fell, unlike the two previous sessions, when the gap widened with both rising. The series high is now behind us, and it belongs to yesterday: 66.50%. The move of the day was Renan Santos, up 0.35pp and breaking nine rounds of decline on the same day as the convention that formally launched him, and the panel records the coincidence of dates without claiming causation. In politics, the [PT](/en/glossary#pt) launched Lula with Alckmin in São Paulo, Missão launched Renan, Flávio attended the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) convention in Santa Catarina, and the two front-runners asked for votes ahead of the legal window. Flávio and Zema still have no running mates three days from the deadline. None of these readings is assigned a cause: the panel records the coincidence of dates and stops there.

bancoMaster.text1: This Sunday the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case produced no new judicial act, and what is on record is what the investigation brought to light. The Federal Police points to Daniel Vorcaro's interest in amendments tabled in the Senate, within a bill regulating the carbon market. That is investigative material, not a decision, and the panel records it as such. The Novo party's complaint against senator Jaques Wagner remains before the Senate Ethics Council, filed on Aug 1, resting on the [PF](/en/glossary#pf) report that became public when André Mendonça lifted secrecy over part of the investigation: 74 calls between the senator and Augusto Lima, a former partner in the bank, between November 2023 and May 2025, totalling more than five hours and thirty minutes of conversation across 555 days.
bancoMaster.text2: The political fact of the case today is that the attempt to keep it out of the election failed. The [PT](/en/glossary#pt) admitted that the deal to keep the Master case out of the Bahia race COLLAPSED. At the state convention on Aug 1, Lula asked for votes for Jaques Wagner, called the ally his government's leader in the Senate and said the Senate is at a low level. Inside the convention itself there was recorded dissonance: Geraldo Júnior was the only one not to mention Wagner in his speech. The panel records the facts side by side and does not turn one into the other: a complaint before the Ethics Council and a formal nomination at a convention are distinct processes, and neither decides the other. Wagner has said publicly that he will prove his innocence. None of this is a conviction.
bancoMaster.text3: On the legislative front there was no news, and the absence remains the fact: the injunction on setting up the Banco Master inquiry committee has sat for more than four months in Kassio Nunes Marques's chambers. Congress returns this week, which puts that front back into possible motion. On price, the record is one of stillness: the market on the impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice held FLAT at 3.10%, in a book of USD 83K, in a fourth straight session at the same value. The caveat from yesterday bears repeating, because it still holds: that contract does NOT price the Wagner case, which runs against a senator and not against a justice.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The fronts of the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) case remain on separate tracks. The criminal one, at the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) under André Mendonça, had its biggest movement on Jul 31, when secrecy was lifted, and this Sunday what surfaced was investigative content, with the Federal Police pointing to Vorcaro's interest in Senate amendments. The asset-freezing one remains before the Rio courts. The legislative one has been stalled for more than four months, and Congress returns this week. The party-political one sits with the Ethics Council. And the front that shares the same rapporteur, without belonging to Master, grew tenser: the two inquiries into Lulinha sharpened the friction between Mendonça and the Federal Police, his lawyer accuses parts of the [PF](/en/glossary#pf) of trying to interfere in the election, and Roberta Luchsinger asked for an investigation into allegedly leaked conversations. The panel records that the same justice concentrates the highest-impact investigations on the eve of the election, and draws no reading of intent from it.

stf.toffoli: Toffoli remains isolated at the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) after the Master crisis, with no new individual act captured this Sunday.
stf.moraes: Questioned Flávio Bolsonaro over the video generated by artificial intelligence shown at the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) convention, and the answer was a NEW video with Jair Bolsonaro, used at the PL convention in Santa Catarina. On the family's personal front, he allowed the sister-in-law to care for Jair Bolsonaro while Michelle underwent tests in Brasília.
stf.gilmar: No individual act from Gilmar in the period. The recent joint vote stands, with Dino, Moraes and Zanin, which reduced restrictions on penduricalhos.
stf.dino: No new act this Sunday. The 10-day deadline set on Jul 29 for the government and Congress to specify the responsibility of members of Congress over budget earmarks is still running.
stf.mendonca: Concentrates the highest-impact investigations of the period, and now with open friction. He remains rapporteur of the inquiry opened on Jul 23 into Vorcaro's transfers for the film about Jair Bolsonaro. On Jul 30 he authorised the first inquiry into influence peddling by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, involving the Health Ministry, and on Jul 31 a SECOND one, over his dealings with Dataprev, besides lifting secrecy over part of the investigation into Jaques Wagner. This Sunday brought no new act, but the press records that the inquiries into Lulinha raised tension between him and the Federal Police.
stf.nexo: This Sunday's thread is NATIONAL CONVENTIONS, with the judicial axis entering through institutional friction. The [PT](/en/glossary#pt) formally launched Lula with Alckmin in São Paulo, bringing together seven parties, and Missão formally launched Renan Santos, also in São Paulo. Flávio Bolsonaro attended the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) convention in Santa Catarina, where he and Carlos Bolsonaro criticised the [STF](/en/glossary#stf), and used a new video with Jair after Moraes questioned him over the previous one, generated by artificial intelligence. Lula and Flávio asked for votes ahead of the legal window, which opens on Aug 16. Flávio and Zema still have no running mates three days from the Aug 5 deadline, and the [Republicanos](/en/glossary#republicanos) national convention, which deals with the presidential alliance, is on Aug 4. On the judicial axis, what carries over from Jul 31 is the tension between Mendonça and the Federal Police around the inquiries into Lulinha, with his lawyer accusing parts of the [PF](/en/glossary#pf) of trying to interfere in the election.
stf.analise: The market on the impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice before 2027 held FLAT at 3.10% (vol USD 83K), with no variation across the two readings of today's capture lock. It is a fourth straight session at the same value. The judicial axis produced news in the period, with two inquiries into Lulinha, secrecy lifted over a senator and open friction between the rapporteur and the Federal Police, but none of it points to the removal of a member of the Court, which is the object of this contract. In a book of USD 83K against USD 118.11M in the presidential market, a price standing still in the face of news that does not touch the object is the expected behaviour.
